## Contribution type

<!-- Select the matching type. Maintainers apply the corresponding labels;

- [ ] MCP server / catalog entry (`mcp-submission`)
- [ ] Skill / Skill Pack (`skill-submission`)
- [ ] Native Toolkit / custom tools (`toolkit-submission`)
- [ ] App bug fix, feature, docs, or other change

Related issue: #<!-- number, if any; an issue is not mandatory for a small PR -->

## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible impact.

## Testing

Describe how you tested the change.

For MCP, Skill, or Toolkit submissions, include the source/version, license,
one usage example, required permissions, side effects, costs, and known
limitations. Distinguish tests you ran from provider claims. MCP catalog
changes must pass `npm run validate:mcp`.
